## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W movers: AMAT (1W: +10.15% | 1M: +28.32%) ABOVE TREND, KHC (1W: +9.74% | 1M: +5.52%) ABOVE TREND, SBUX (1W: +8.65% | 1M: -3.47%) RECOVERY; Major divergence present — several mega-cap Techs differing across 1W vs 1M (AAPL, IBM, NOW), flagging tactical risk.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Tech: 6/24 positive (Sector Weakness). Core large-caps struggling: MSFT (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -4.07%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.31% | 1M: -7.10%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -3.82% | 1M: -7.58%) BELOW TREND; but semicap leaders AMAT (1W: +10.15% | 1M: +28.32%) ABOVE TREND and LRCX (1W: +7.76% | 1M: +25.34%) ABOVE TREND show pocket strength.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials: 14/20 positive (Sector Strength). JPM (1W: +0.84% | 1M: +2.82%) ABOVE TREND provides stability while MA (1W: +0.99% | 1M: -2.66%) RECOVERY and V (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -2.26%) BELOW TREND show dispersion; sentiment headlines on swipe-fee settlement and subpoenas add event risk.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare: 11/17 positive (Internal Rotation). JNJ (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +6.89%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.29% | 1M: +2.31%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +3.17% | 1M: +17.48%) ABOVE TREND — defensive support amid mixed Tech.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor exposure to Financials and Consumer Staples while reducing exposure to stretched large-cap Tech that is BELOW TREND; style mixed / no clear leadership — be selective and prefer names with confirmed ABOVE TREND profiles.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +10.15% | 1M: +28.32%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +7.76% | 1M: +25.34%) ABOVE TREND, HD (1W: +5.18% | 1M: +5.80%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: MSFT (1W: -8.81% | 1M: -4.07%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -9.42% | 1M: -5.73%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -22.10% | 1M: -1.46%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Consumer Staples (11/14 positive, Sector Strength), Financials (14/20 positive, Sector Strength).  
BEARISH: Technology (6/24 positive, Sector Weakness), Energy and Materials showing continued pressure.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch NVDA: failure to reclaim a 5% bounce would keep the stock BELOW TREND and at risk; AAPL: a 5% reclaim above recent 1W highs would shift CORRECTION toward stabilization; JPM: a 2% move above recent intraday highs would confirm ABOVE TREND continuation; AMAT: sustained weekly follow-through above this week’s gain would reinforce ABOVE TREND momentum.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**

(Notes: broader bullish news list includes BLK and BAC but those tickers lack dual-timeframe detail in today’s feed.)

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
MA (-80): MA (1W: +0.99% | 1M: -2.66%) RECOVERY — heavy negative headlines on swipe-fee settlement while price is short-term positive, watch for follow-through.  
V (-80): V (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -2.26%) BELOW TREND — news-driven pressure confirming underlying softness.  
JPM (-45): JPM (1W: +0.84% | 1M: +2.82%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines (subpoena) are a risk event despite its ABOVE TREND status.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive and Top 5 leadership is Broad (4 sectors), supporting a neutral, selective posture.  
AMAT (1W: +10.15% | 1M: +28.32%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +7.76% | 1M: +25.34%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +6.89%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength.  
Key risk: concentrated mega-cap Tech cluster (MSFT, NVDA, META) BELOW TREND and mixed sentiment (ADBE bullish headlines but price BELOW TREND) — watch for trend-confirming follow-through.
